texts.preamble: Pramod Kumar Sahu @ Pramod Sahu vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Parties on 14 November, 2022 Author: R.K. Pattanaik Bench: R.K. Pattanaik In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack Crlmc No. 1017 of 2022 Pramod Kumar Sahu @ Pramod Sahu .... Petitioner Mr. B.P.Das, Advocate -Versus- State of Odisha .... Opposite Parties Mr. S.S.Mohapatra, Asc Coram:
texts.arguments: 2. Mr. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner confines his argument while challenging the order of cognizance under Anneuxre-2 vis--vis the offences under Section 272 and 273 IPC on the ground that Gutkha is not a food item while referring to the definition of food contained in Section 3(j) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006. At the same time, Mr. Das refers to a citation of the Kerala High Court in Joshy K.V. Vrs. State of Kerala in W.P.(C) No. 13580 of 2012(V) decided on 20th December, 2012, wherein, it has been held that offences under Section 272 and 273 IPC cannot be attracted in respect of Tobacco products. 3.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. Mr. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner confines his argument while challenging the order of cognizance under Anneuxre-2 vis--vis the offences under Section 272 and 273 IPC on the ground that Gutkha is not a food item while referring to the definition of food contained in Section 3(j) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006. At the same time, Mr. Das refers to a citation of the Kerala High Court in Joshy K.V. Vrs. State of Kerala in W.P.(C) No. 13580 of 2012(V) decided on 20th December, 2012, wherein, it has been held that offences under Section 272 and 273 IPC cannot be attracted in respect of Tobacco products. 3.
